articles.title: China-Slovakia people-to-people exchanges deepen bilateral ties
articles.titleCn: 中斯人文交流深化双边关系
articles.summary: From visa-free policies and educational exchanges to cultural cooperation and city-to-city partnerships, China and Slovakia have steadily expanded people-to-people exchanges, strengthening public support for the long-term development of bilateral ties.
articles.summaryCn: 中国与斯洛伐克通过教育合作、文化活动和签证便利化，持续深化人文交流，夯实双边关系基础。

paragraphs.en:
Young people from Slovak Association of Chinese Wushu dressed in traditional Chinese martial arts costumes at the Dragon Boat Festival event, Bratislava, capital of Slovakia, June 18, 2026. /The Confucius Institute in Bratislava
The gentle {{0}} of the pipa, erhu and guzheng floated through the air as guests wrapped freshly made zongzi and tried their hand at Chinese calligraphy. In mid-June this year, Chinese students joined local lovers of Chinese culture at the Confucius Institute in Bratislava, Slovakia, to celebrate the Dragon Boat Festival, one of China's oldest and most {{1}} traditions. "More Slovak friends are welcome to visit China and see for themselves the country's developmental {{2}} and cultural charm," said Chinese Ambassador to Slovakia Cai Ge, adding that such visits are now much easier than ever. Since November 2024, China has {{3}} a {{4}} visa-free entry for Slovak ordinary passport holders for business, tourism, family visits and transit, and later extended the policy through the end of 2026.
paragraphs.cn: 来自斯洛伐克武术协会的年轻人身着中国传统武术服装，参加2026年6月18日在斯洛伐克首都布拉迪斯拉发举行的端午节活动。/布拉迪斯拉发孔子学院。琵琶、二胡和古筝的悠扬旋律在空中飘荡，客人们包裹着新鲜制作的粽子和尝试中国书法。今年6月中旬，中国学生与当地中国文化爱好者齐聚斯洛伐克布拉迪斯拉发孔子学院，庆祝中国最古老、最珍视的传统节日之一——端午节。中国驻斯洛伐克大使蔡革表示：“欢迎更多斯洛伐克朋友访问中国，亲眼见证国家的发展活力和文化魅力。”他补充说，此类访问现在比以往任何时候都更加便捷。自2024年11月起，中国对斯洛伐克普通护照持有者实施单方面免签入境政策，适用于商务、旅游、探亲及过境，随后将该政策延长至2026年底。

paragraphs.en:
Welcoming the move, Slovak Minister of Foreign and European Affairs Juraj Blanar said it would serve as a very important tool to {{5}} tourism and {{6}} business cooperation between the two countries, particularly amid global challenges. The interactions reflect a broader trend in bilateral relations, where China and Slovakia have steadily expanded people-to-people exchanges, strengthening public support for the long-term development of partnership. Education builds lasting bridge
Education has become one of the strongest {{7}} of China-Slovakia people-to-people cooperation. The Chinese and Slovak education ministries signed a bilateral agreement on {{8}} education this January, further strengthening {{9}} support for educational cooperation. One of the most {{10}} examples can be found in the historic central Slovak city of Banska Bystrica, where Chinese is now taught as an official language of instruction at Mikulas Kovac Secondary School, carrying the same {{11}} weight and {{12}} standards as Slovak.
paragraphs.cn: 斯洛伐克外交和欧洲事务部长尤拉伊·布拉纳尔对此举表示欢迎，称这将是促进两国旅游和深化商业合作的重要工具，尤其是在全球挑战背景下。这些互动反映了双边关系的更广泛趋势，中国和斯洛伐克稳步扩大人文交流，为伙伴关系的长期发展加强公众支持。教育搭建持久桥梁。教育已成为中斯人文合作最坚实的支柱之一。今年1月，中国和斯洛伐克教育部签署了双语教育双边协议，进一步加强了教育合作的制度支持。最显著的例子之一可以在斯洛伐克中部历史名城班斯卡-比斯特里察找到，在那里，中文现已成为米库拉什·科瓦奇中学的官方教学语言，与斯洛伐克语具有相同的学术权重和评估标准。

paragraphs.en:
Beyond language instruction, educational cooperation between the two countries has also created broader opportunities for academic {{13}} and cultural exchange, helping more Slovaks gain a deeper understanding of China. Established in 2007 at the Slovak University of Technology in Bratislava, the Confucius Institute was the first of its kind in Slovakia. It now operates two Confucius Classrooms and 11 teaching centers, has trained more than 8,000 students and organized cultural activities that have recorded over 50,000 {{14}}. Ningbo University of Finance and Economics and Bratislava University of Economics and Management sign an agreement to establish the China Culture Communication Center at the 10th anniversary of their partnership, east China's Zhejiang Province, June 9, 2026. /Ningbo University of Finance and Economics
By signing an agreement to establish the China Culture Communication Center, Ningbo University of Finance and Economics and Bratislava University of Economics and Management marked the 10th anniversary of their partnership in June.
paragraphs.cn: 除了语言教学，两国之间的教育合作还为学术协作和文化交流创造了更广泛的机会，帮助更多斯洛伐克人加深对中国的了解。布拉迪斯拉发孔子学院成立于2007年，位于斯洛伐克理工大学，是斯洛伐克首家此类机构。它目前运营着两所孔子课堂和11个教学中心，已培训超过8000名学生，并组织了参与人数超过5万的文化活动。宁波财经学院和布拉迪斯拉发经济与管理大学于2026年6月9日在中国东部浙江省签署协议，建立中国文化传播中心，以纪念双方合作十周年。/宁波财经学院。通过签署建立中国文化传播中心的协议，宁波财经学院和布拉迪斯拉发经济与管理大学于6月庆祝了双方合作十周年。

paragraphs.en:
The center will provide cultural exchanges and {{15}} studies besides language education, while also offering training programs for employees of Chinese enterprises operating in Slovakia. Over the past decade, the two universities have leveraged the co-founded Silk Road College to exchange 94 students and more than 40 faculty members, as the cooperation has also expanded to talent-training programs to prepare {{16}} for Chinese-invested enterprises in Slovakia. Cultural exchanges broaden mutual understanding
As educational ties continue to grow, cultural exchanges have added another {{17}} to the relationship, bringing the Chinese and Slovak peoples closer through film, music and the arts. The International Chinese Language Day, as well as the 2026 Chinese Film Festival was held in April at the Slovak National Gallery in Bratislava, drawing nearly 200 guests from government, cultural and academic circles. Addressing the opening ceremony, Slovak Culture Ministry International Cooperation Director Branislav Salat recalled the decades-long bilateral ties, saying "culture has always been one of the most important bridges connecting our two countries."
The event featured young Chinese and Slovaks reciting the classical Chinese poem "Thoughts on a Tranquil Night" in Chinese, Slovak and English, and the screening of "A Tapestry of a Legendary Land," a dance drama inspired by a renowned Chinese painting masterpiece from the Song Dynasty (960–1279).
paragraphs.cn: 该中心将提供文化交流和比较研究，以及语言教育，同时为在斯洛伐克运营的中国企业员工提供培训项目。过去十年间，这两所大学利用共同创办的丝绸之路学院，交流了94名学生和40多名教职员工，合作还扩展到人才培养项目，为斯洛伐克的中资企业培养专业人才。文化交流拓宽相互理解。随着教育联系的持续增长，文化交流为两国关系增添了另一个维度，通过电影、音乐和艺术拉近了中斯人民的距离。国际中文日以及2026年中国电影节于4月在布拉迪斯拉发的斯洛伐克国家美术馆举行，吸引了近200名来自政府、文化和学术界的嘉宾。斯洛伐克文化部国际合作司司长布拉尼斯拉夫·萨拉特在开幕式上致辞，回顾了数十年的双边关系，称“文化一直是连接我们两国最重要的桥梁之一。”活动上，中斯青年用中文、斯洛伐克语和英语朗诵了中国古典诗歌《静夜思》，并放映了受宋代（960-1279）著名中国画杰作启发的舞蹈剧《只此青绿》。

Four other contemporary Chinese films were also screened during the week-long festival, with several showings fully booked, reflecting growing local interest in Chinese cinema. The opening ceremony of International Chinese Language Day, as well as the 2026 Chinese Film Festival was held at the Slovak National Gallery in Bratislava, capital of Slovakia, April 10, 2026. /The Chinese Embassy in Slovakia
In September 2025, China Media Group, together with the Chinese Embassy in Slovakia and Slovakia's Ministry of Culture, launched the Slovak-language version of the documentary "L.E. HUDEC," which tells the story of Laszlo Hudec, the Slovak-born architect whose landmark buildings helped shape Shanghai's skyline in the first half of the 20th century. Broadcast in prime time on Slovakia's national television, the documentary not only introduced audiences to Hudec's architectural {{18}} but also shed light on the deep historical connections between the two peoples, Ambassador Cai said.

paragraphs.en:
Where cities connect, friendship grows
While government-to-government cooperation is expanding, local partnerships have increasingly translated diplomatic ties into practical collaboration, creating new opportunities in education, tourism, scientific research and youth exchanges. Shanghai and Slovakia's Bratislava Self-Governing Region signed friendship city agreements in 2003 and celebrated the 20th anniversary of the partnership in 2023. More recently, cooperation has spread across different parts of both countries. During a visit to Zhengzhou, central China's Henan Province, in 2025, the mayor of the Slovak town of Brezno reached a series of agreements with Chinese partners covering tourism promotion, education and sports. Local tourism authorities signed a memorandum of understanding, while schools and universities agreed to expand educational exchanges and explore joint degree programs.
paragraphs.cn: 城市相连，友谊增长。在政府间合作不断扩大的同时，地方伙伴关系日益将外交关系转化为实际合作，在教育、旅游、科学研究和青年交流方面创造新机遇。上海与斯洛伐克的布拉迪斯拉发自治州于2003年签署友好城市协议，并于2023年庆祝了伙伴关系20周年。最近，合作已扩展到两国不同地区。2025年，斯洛伐克布雷兹诺镇市长访问中国中部河南省郑州市期间，与中国合作伙伴达成了一系列协议，涵盖旅游推广、教育和体育。地方旅游部门签署了谅解备忘录，而中小学和大学同意扩大教育交流并探索联合学位项目。

paragraphs.en: At the seventh China-Central and Eastern European Countries Local Leaders' Meeting, held in Jinan, east China's Shandong Province, in May, participants expressed hope for more dialogue, reciprocal visits and practical cooperation between China and Slovakia. Among those helping turn that vision into reality is Slovak agricultural scientist Miroslava Kacaniova, who has maintained long-term research partnerships with Chinese institutions including Shandong University and Zhejiang University. "China's advances in smart technologies can complement Slovakia's expertise in agricultural research," she noted. "Together, we can address shared challenges such as climate change and food security."
paragraphs.cn: 在5月于中国东部山东省济南市举行的第七届中国-中东欧国家地方领导人会议上，与会者表达了中斯之间更多对话、互访和务实合作的希望。帮助将这一愿景变为现实的人之一是斯洛伐克农业科学家米罗斯拉娃·卡察尼奥娃，她与山东大学和浙江大学等中国机构保持着长期研究伙伴关系。她指出：“中国在智能技术方面的进步可以补充斯洛伐克在农业研究方面的专长。我们可以共同应对气候变化和粮食安全等共同挑战。”

articles.fullText:
As people age, many experience memory decline and slower cognitive processing, along with a higher risk of cerebrovascular disease and cognitive impairment. One important question in aging research is how changes in the brain's blood vessels contribute to cognitive decline.
Scientists from the Shenzhen Institutes of Advanced Technology (SIAT) of the Chinese Academy of Sciences have identified a mechanism by which aging weakens the blood-brain barrier, the brain's protective interface with the bloodstream.
The study was published in Neuron under the title "TGF-β1-induced endothelial transcytosis drives blood-brain barrier leakage during aging."
The study shows how aging disrupts transport in brain blood vessel cells, leading to blood-brain barrier leakage. /SIAT
The blood-brain barrier, or BBB, acts as a selective security system. It allows essential nutrients to reach the brain while preventing potentially harmful substances in the blood from entering brain tissue. Damage to this barrier has been linked to cognitive aging, cerebral small vessel disease and several neurodegenerative disorders.
Scientists have traditionally attributed BBB leakage mainly to damage to the tight seals between cells lining brain blood vessels. However, the new study found that another process occurs earlier during aging.
By examining mice at different ages, the researchers found that BBB leakage was already detectable in middle-aged mice and worsened in older animals. The change appeared early in the hippocampus, a brain region important for learning and memory.
At this stage, the seals between blood vessel cells remained largely intact. Instead, the cells' internal transport system became abnormally active, allowing blood-borne substances to pass through the cells and enter brain tissue.
"Rather than first leaking through gaps between cells, the aging blood-brain barrier appears to lose control over transport pathways inside the cells," the researchers said.
The team identified a protein called Mfsd2a as an important part of this protective system. Mfsd2a normally limits unnecessary transport across brain blood vessels. Its levels declined with age, while Caveolin-1, a protein involved in the formation of transport vesicles, increased.
When the researchers restored endothelial Mfsd2a expression or knocked down Caveolin-1 in aged mice, abnormal vesicle transport and BBB leakage were significantly reduced.
The researchers then investigated why Mfsd2a declines during aging. They found that levels of TGF-β1, a signaling molecule involved in inflammation, tissue repair and aging, increased in both the brain and the bloodstream as mice aged.
Excessive TGF-β1 reduced Mfsd2a expression in the cells lining brain blood vessels, causing their transport activity to increase. Raising TGF-β1 levels in young mice caused them to develop several features normally seen in the aged BBB, including increased leakage.
By contrast, blocking TGF-β signaling in aged mice reduced BBB leakage and improved their performance in memory-related behavioral tests.
The findings suggest that age-related BBB damage is not simply the result of passive wear and tear. Instead, it involves biological signals that alter how brain blood vessel cells transport substances.
The study may help explain how vascular changes contribute to cognitive aging. It also points to potential approaches for protecting the aging brain, including maintaining Mfsd2a function or preventing excessive activation of TGF-β signaling. Further research will be needed to determine whether these strategies can be safely translated into treatments for humans.

paragraphs.en: According to Wu, AI-generated traffic is expected to account for around 60% of global internet traffic by 2030, with AI agent services becoming the dominant source of token-based interactions. The shift, he said, will require internet {{7}} to evolve toward higher bandwidth, lower {{8}} and stronger computing capabilities. Digital twin technologies are enabling more efficient traffic management, energy optimization and building maintenance, providing city managers with real-time {{10}} and decision-making tools. articles.fullText:
International Tiger Day, observed on July 29, highlights how tiger conservation is increasingly focused not only on recovering populations but also on restoring the ecosystems that sustain them.
A Siberian tiger. 
Spanning 14,100 square kilometers, the Northeast China Tiger and Leopard National Park is home to around 72 wild Siberian tigers, making it one of the species' most important strongholds in China.
Supported by an integrated monitoring system combining camera traps, satellite remote sensing and aerial surveys, AI-powered stripe-pattern recognition helps researchers identify individual tigers and track their movements, while long-term monitoring provides valuable data for conservation planning.
Its approach reflects a broader shift from protecting individual animals to conserving the ecosystems they depend on.
A white tiger at the National Zoological Park in New Delhi, India, November 10, 2025. 
That approach mirrors a global trend. According to World Wildlife Fund, an estimated 5,574 wild tigers remain worldwide today, up significantly from an estimated 3,200 in 2010. Much of the recovery has been reported in India, Nepal and Bhutan, while Russia and China have also recorded population recovery.
Populations in parts of Southeast Asia, however, continue to face severe pressure from habitat loss, poaching and human-wildlife conflict. The next challenge is no longer increasing tiger numbers, but reconnecting fragmented habitats and improving coexistence between people and wildlife.
Ten-week-old Sumatran tiger cubs at Taman Safari Indonesia in Pasuruan in East Java province, Indonesia, June 4, 2026. 
Earlier this year, the International Union for Conservation of Nature announced six initiatives across Bhutan, India, Indonesia, Malaysia, Nepal and Thailand that combine habitat restoration, wildlife corridors, community participation and conflict mitigation.
Rather than focusing on protected areas alone, the projects aim to reconnect forests across national boundaries and strengthen connected ecosystems.
A Siberian tiger undergoes rewilding and hunting training at the Hengdaohezi Siberian Tiger Park in Mudanjiang, Heilongjiang Province, northeast China, February 21, 2026. 
A recent study published in the Frontiers in Conservation Science journal likewise argues that long-term tiger recovery depends on maintaining ecological connectivity and integrating conservation with local livelihoods.
A tiger is pictured at the Tiger House hospice for wild cats in Roshchino, 60 km northwest of St Petersburg, Russia, July 24, 2026. 
China's efforts are also extending beyond its borders. In 2024, China and Russia agreed to establish the "Land of Big Cats," a transboundary conservation area linking about 18,000 square kilometers of tiger and leopard habitat.
In Kazakhstan, Siberian tigers were released this year as part of an internationally supported effort to restore tigers to parts of their former range, where the Caspian tiger became extinct decades ago.
Siberian tiger cubs in Yangzhou Zoo, Jiangsu Province, east China, June 17, 2026. 
These initiatives show how tiger conservation is evolving from protecting a single species to safeguarding the connected landscapes on which both wildlife and people depend.

articles.summary: The contest to choose the next Secretary-General of the United Nations has expanded, with Uganda's Olara Otunnu becoming the seventh official candidate seeking to lead the global body.

Uganda nominates Olara Otunnu to {{0}} for the UN Secretary-General position, July 26, 2026. /Uganda Ministry of Foreign Affairs
The contest to choose the next Secretary-General of the United Nations has {{1}}, with Uganda's Olara Otunnu becoming the seventh official candidate seeking to lead the global body. The United Nations on Saturday informed member states that Uganda had formally {{2}} the 75-year-old {{3}}, who has held senior positions within the UN and previously contested Uganda's presidency. The successful candidate will {{4}} Antonio Guterres, whose second five-year term ends on December 31, 2026. The new UN chief is expected to {{5}} office on January 1, 2027.
paragraphs.cn:
乌干达提名奥拉拉·奥图努角逐联合国秘书长职位，2026年7月26日。/乌干达外交部
下任联合国秘书长的竞选队伍进一步扩大，乌干达的奥拉拉·奥图努成为第七位正式候选人，寻求领导这一全球机构。联合国周六通知各成员国，乌干达已正式提名这位75岁的外交官，他曾在联合国担任高级职务，并曾竞选乌干达总统。胜选者将接替安东尼奥·古特雷斯，其第二个五年任期将于2026年12月31日结束。新任联合国负责人预计将于2027年1月1日就职。

paragraphs.en:
Veteran diplomat with UN experience
Otunnu brings decades of diplomatic and international leadership experience to the race. From 1997 to 2005, he served as United Nations Under-Secretary-General and Special Representative for Children and Armed Conflict under then Secretary-General Kofi Annan. During his {{7}}, he led global efforts to protect children affected by war and {{8}} for stronger international measures against the {{9}} of child soldiers. Before that, Otunnu served as Uganda's Permanent Representative to the United Nations and briefly held the position of Foreign Minister. Beyond diplomacy, he entered domestic politics and was the presidential candidate for the opposition Uganda People's Congress (UPC) in the 2011 general election, where he was defeated by longtime President Yoweri Museveni, who has been in power since 1986.
paragraphs.cn:
拥有联合国经验的资深外交官
奥图努为竞选带来了数十年的外交和国际领导经验。从1997年到2005年，他担任联合国副秘书长兼儿童与武装冲突问题特别代表，任职于时任秘书长科菲·安南之下。任职期间，他领导了保护受战争影响儿童的全球努力，并倡导采取更强有力的国际措施打击招募儿童兵的行为。在此之前，奥图努曾担任乌干达常驻联合国代表，并短暂担任外交部长。在外交领域之外，他涉足国内政治，并在2011年大选中作为反对党乌干达人民大会党的总统候选人，败给了自1986年以来一直执政的长期总统约韦里·穆塞韦尼。

paragraphs.en:
Seven candidates in the running
Otunnu joins six other candidates {{10}} to become the UN's next Secretary-General:
Macky Sall (Senegal)
Michelle Bachelet (Chile)
Maria Fernanda Espinosa (Ecuador)
Rafael Grossi (Argentina)
Rebeca Grynspan (Costa Rica)
Macky Sall, former president of Senegal and candidate to be secretary-general of the United Nations, July 23, 2026. /CFP
The six previously announced candidates participated in a televised public dialogue on Thursday, {{11}} their visions for the future of the United Nations. The selection process now moves to the UN Security Council, where the 15-member body is scheduled to hold its first {{12}} "straw poll" on July 30. During these informal secret ballots, council members indicate their level of support for each candidate. Several rounds of voting are typically held until one candidate secures the required nine votes while avoiding a {{13}} from any of the Council's five permanent members, the United States, the United Kingdom, China, France, and Russia.

Uganda nominates Olara Otunnu to contest for the UN Secretary-General position, July 26, 2026. /Uganda Ministry of Foreign Affairs
The contest to choose the next Secretary-General of the United Nations has expanded, with Uganda's Olara Otunnu becoming the seventh official candidate seeking to lead the global body.
The United Nations on Saturday informed member states that Uganda had formally nominated the 75-year-old diplomat, who has held senior positions within the UN and previously contested Uganda's presidency.
The successful candidate will succeed Antonio Guterres, whose second five-year term ends on December 31, 2026. The new UN chief is expected to assume office on January 1, 2027.
Veteran diplomat with UN experience
Otunnu brings decades of diplomatic and international leadership experience to the race. From 1997 to 2005, he served as United Nations Under-Secretary-General and Special Representative for Children and Armed Conflict under then Secretary-General Kofi Annan.
During his tenure, he led global efforts to protect children affected by war and advocated for stronger international measures against the recruitment of child soldiers.
Before that, Otunnu served as Uganda's Permanent Representative to the United Nations and briefly held the position of Foreign Minister.
Beyond diplomacy, he entered domestic politics and was the presidential candidate for the opposition Uganda People's Congress (UPC) in the 2011 general election, where he was defeated by longtime President Yoweri Museveni, who has been in power since 1986.
Seven candidates in the running
Otunnu joins six other candidates vying to become the UN's next Secretary-General:
Macky Sall (Senegal)
Michelle Bachelet (Chile)
Maria Fernanda Espinosa (Ecuador)
Rafael Grossi (Argentina)
Rebeca Grynspan (Costa Rica)
Macky Sall, former president of Senegal and candidate to be secretary-general of the United Nations, July 23, 2026. /CFP
The six previously announced candidates participated in a televised public dialogue on Thursday, outlining their visions for the future of the United Nations.
The selection process now moves to the UN Security Council, where the 15-member body is scheduled to hold its first confidential "straw poll" on July 30.
During these informal secret ballots, council members indicate their level of support for each candidate. Several rounds of voting are typically held until one candidate secures the required nine votes while avoiding a veto from any of the Council's five permanent members, the United States, the United Kingdom, China, France, and Russia.
Once the Security Council agrees on a single nominee, it will recommend that candidate to the UN General Assembly, which will formally appoint the next Secretary-General.
The individual selected will become the 10th Secretary-General of the United Nations, taking office on January 1, 2027, for a renewable five-year term.

下任联合国秘书长的竞选队伍进一步扩大，乌干达的奥拉拉·奥图努成为第七位正式候选人，寻求领导这一全球机构。联合国周六通知各成员国，乌干达已正式提名这位75岁的外交官，他曾在联合国担任高级职务，并曾竞选乌干达总统。胜选者将接替安东尼奥·古特雷斯，其第二个五年任期将于2026年12月31日结束。新任联合国负责人预计将于2027年1月1日就职。

奥图努为竞选带来了数十年的外交和国际领导经验。从1997年到2005年，他担任联合国副秘书长兼儿童与武装冲突问题特别代表，任职于时任秘书长科菲·安南之下。任职期间，他领导了保护受战争影响儿童的全球努力，并倡导采取更强有力的国际措施打击招募儿童兵的行为。在此之前，奥图努曾担任乌干达常驻联合国代表，并短暂担任外交部长。在外交领域之外，他涉足国内政治，并在2011年大选中作为反对党乌干达人民大会党的总统候选人，败给了自1986年以来一直执政的长期总统约韦里·穆塞韦尼。
